Does this sound familiar?

High standards aren’t the problem. The pattern is.

  • Planning the dates, keeping the conversation going, doing most of the work.
  • Being drawn to chemistry that turns into confusion a few weeks in.
  • Being told to “lower your standards” when that was never the issue.
  • Finding it easier to give than to let someone show up for you.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why high standards and an open heart can go together

The difference between standards and walls, and why you don’t have to settle to be met.

The over-giving loop

How the skills that make you brilliant at work can turn into over-functioning in love, and how to step out of it.

Leading vs receiving

What conscious dating looks like when you stop running it like a project and let a partner step forward.

Spotting love that expands, early

The first-date signals that tell you whether a connection will grow you or drain you.

A simple embodiment practice

A short daily practice to feel grounded and at ease in yourself before, during and after a date.

Script 1 · “Lower your standards”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The worst dating advice successful women get? ‘Lower your standards.’”

Body

“Standards aren’t the problem. What often gets in the way is doing all the holding: planning, chasing, keeping it going. When that stops, the right people have room to step forward. That’s what conscious dating is.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s £17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera in a warm café setting, cream and butter-yellow tones.

Script 2 · “The CEO on a date”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Running a date like a meeting? Here’s why it can backfire.”

Body

“At work, leading is everything. In love, constant leading can leave no space to be met. Receiving is a skill, and like any skill it can be practised. It starts with noticing when you’re over-giving.”

CTA

“In the Love That Expands Masterclass I’ll show you how. Live, 60 minutes, £17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “receiving” highlighted in deep red.

Script 3 · “Expands or exhausts”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“One question tells you if a connection will expand you or exhaust you.”

Body

“After time together, how do you feel? More like yourself, or like you’ve been working? Chemistry can feel exciting and still leave you drained. Love that expands feels calm, steady and easy to be in.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through the early signs in my live masterclass. Seats are £17. Tap Sign up below.”
